OBJECT_A.lot_verdict: REFINED — driven entirely by 33058734's three understatements and the propagation-text omission. Nothing fabricated in either paper; every quoted snippet found in the artefact it names.
OBJECT_A.claim_1_unlisted_fourth_leg: CONFIRMED in all seven checkable components — DL-MECH-012 names 36828035, 39868255 and 38563965 and 33058734 is genuinely absent; peer-reviewed, same laboratory, same endothelial knockout, same tissue, cited by the lung leg as its own ref 3; both legend titles state the negative verbatim; the authors' inflammation-independent conclusion verbatim; JNK inhibited without rescue verbatim; and no significance mark on any bar — 24 of them, not the twelve the contract states. 🔴 ONE QUALIFICATION THAT CHANGES WHAT MAY BE CONCLUDED: 'measures lung inflammation twice and does not find it' is true of the two BAL measurements and not of the paper. It measures inflammatory output a THIRD time, in endothelial cells sorted from the same animals, and FINDS it significant on all three analytes (Fig 8). The producer's entries[31] and dossier DATO item 10 both record this; the dispatching brief and the propagation text do not. So the honest qualification is that the axis's lung limb is compartment- and stimulus-bounded, not that the direction is wrong, and a non-significant n=3 comparison with overlapping error bars is NOT a demonstrated null.
OBJECT_A.claim_2_revival_trigger: ANSWERED, and more completely than claimed. The trigger asked for system, species, and whether basal endothelial WWOX is shown by any method: all three are on the record. Basal endothelial WWOX is demonstrated by TWO INDEPENDENT METHODS IN EACH PAPER — immunoblot (f001A, f003A) and immunofluorescence (f001B) in human pulmonary artery EC; RT-PCR (fig2C) and Western (fig2D) in sorted mouse lung EC. The DEFAULT_FROM_TEXTBOOK premise dissolves on its own terms. 'Compatible, not reconciled' tested in BOTH directions and found HONEST, not a softening: compatible because the two observations are about different objects (FFPE capillary IHC with one antibody and no EC co-marker, versus cultured arterial EC and sorted murine lung EC), so neither refutes the other; not reconciled because nothing explains the difference and no one has assayed the same compartment by both routes. A softening would have said 'resolved' or 'contradicted'; this asserts neither and leaves the tension live.
OBJECT_A.claim_3_data_independence: BOTH HALVES CORRECT AND CORRECTLY KEPT APART. Shared at three levels: the same Aldaz founder floxed allele, the same EC-specific strain ('previously validated by our group (3)', where ref 3 IS the 2021 paper), the same senior laboratory. Independent substantively: new animals, different injury class (infectious at 18 h vs mechanical at 4 h), different human cell type (lung MICROVASCULAR vs pulmonary ARTERY EC, both called 'ECs'), n=3 vs n=10, and uncorrected t/ANOVA vs two-way ANOVA with Tukey. So independent data, shared material, NOT external replication. Neither warned-against implication is available: a shared founder allele does not make the measurements shared, and independent measurements in one laboratory on one strain are not external replication. The producer's sharpest point HOLDS and is the lot's most valuable sentence: the pair does not corroborate itself on inflammation but SPLITS — where the questions touch, 33058734 answers no on every analyte and 38563965 answers yes on every analyte.
OBJECT_A.page_render_adjudication_judgement: IT CARRIES all 22 text propositions. regenerate_adjudications.py verify returns 22/22 digests matched AND — the part that bears on the propositions — 22/22 locators resolved to a span inside the crop that shows them, each against the snippet it names. I opened six crops myself and read the drawn text directly. The text layer was refused on a stated, checkable ground (zero of < > <= >= +/- x - in 59,006 chars; an independent font screen returning UNTRUSTWORTHY for the symbol subset), which is exactly the condition rules 5d/5e are written for: where no trustworthy text surface exists, the drawn glyph adjudicates, and a page render of the printed page is a HIGHER-fidelity surface than a suspect extraction. TWO BOUNDED CAVEATS: the tool verifies recipes and explicitly does not read the on-disk PNGs (evidence_presence.py closes that from the other side at 46/46, and both were run); and a glyph read cannot support claims about encoding or hidden characters, on which no proposition here rests. ONE STRUCTURAL FINDING: all 32 entries are typed surface 'figure', so the schema can no longer distinguish a page-rendered sentence from a figure-panel attestation — reached independently by me from the manifest and by the producer from the validator (M4b §K), which measured the cost at three affected panel-to-text relations and refused to force a false enum value. Convergent, and a schema decision for the operator.
